messages.subject: Issue With Example
messages.body_plain:
I have had trouble running this example:

_________________________________
## Not run:
wb <- createWorkbook()
sheet <- createSheet(wb, "Sheet1")
rows <- createRow(sheet, rowIndex=1)
cell.1 <- createCell(rows, colIndex=1)[[1,1]]
setCellValue(cell.1, "Hello R!")
cs <- CellStyle(wb) +
Font(wb, heightInPoints=20, isBold=TRUE, isItalic=TRUE,
name="Courier New", color="orange") +
Fill(backgroundColor="lavender", foregroundColor="lavender",
pattern="SOLID_FOREGROUND") +
Alignment(h="ALIGN_RIGHT")
setCellStyle(cell.1, cellStyle1)

# you need to save the workbook now if you want to see this art
## End(Not run)
___________________________________

I had to change setCellStyle(cell.1, cellStyle1) to setCellStyle(cell.1, cs), or I think that is what I think I should do.  Even then, I am not seeing the font being changed to Courier New, and the font color is not being changed to orange.  Neither is the size or bold or italic properties.  Any help?
